reviews.source_text: Participants must meet all the following criteria to be included in the trial:
reviews.note: List introduction only.

reviews.source_text: * Age18 to 85 years.
reviews.note: numeric fields did not pass the source-value check

reviews.source_text: * Participant has a diagnosis of MDD (single or recurrent episode as defined by DSM-5 TR \[if single episode, duration of ≥4 weeks and ≤24 months\] and established as per evaluation by the Investigator. The first MDD episode must have occurred prior to age 60.
reviews.note: The single-episode duration bounds are conditional, so the full line cannot be represented safely as flat annotations.

reviews.source_text: * Moderate to severe depression at Screening and Baseline, independently confirmed.
reviews.note: No instrument or objective threshold defines moderate-to-severe depression at Screening and Baseline.

reviews.source_text: * Participants have been on a stable dose of antidepressant medication (label specified) at an adequate dose in the last 4 weeks prior to Screening and has had an inadequate response (less than 50% improvement), as judged by the Investigator.
reviews.note: Dose adequacy and inadequate response are investigator-judged; the 4-week wording does not support a standalone exact duration rule.

reviews.source_text: * Participants capable of producing sperm must use a condom plus spermicide during the trial and for 12 weeks after their final dose of trial medication, if their partner is a person of childbearing potential.
reviews.note: The contraception requirement applies only when both participant and partner reproductive-status conditions are met.

reviews.source_text: * Participants of childbearing potential who have a partner capable of producing sperm must agree to use a highly effective method of contraception in combination with the use of a condom plus spermicide during the trial and for 12 weeks after their final dose of trial medication. Such participants must have a negative pregnancy test at Screening and Day 1 prior to dosing.
reviews.note: Requirements apply only when both reproductive-status and partner conditions are met.

reviews.source_text: * Participants of non-childbearing potential who are or were capable of producing eggs (ova) must have been postmenopausal or permanently sterile following hysterectomy, bilateral salpingectomy, or bilateral oophorectomy.
reviews.note: The criterion contains alternative qualifying states and procedures that cannot be represented as conjunctive annotations.
